encoding_note: Payment/drop-gold/guild/return/create strings are GBK Chinese (cp949 decode fails); storage-full/reject strings are CP949 Korean (GBK/GB18030 decode yields mojibake). The EI 3.0 client ships a Korean-to-Chinese localization in progress with both encodings present. 0x565994 is a resource pointer (empty when read as string).
confirmed: Frames 151/152, 154/155, 157/158 (plus normals 150/153/156) are button state resources; exact roles: YES/middle/NO with normal/hover/pressed triple mapping via button ctor arg order.
Frame 950 (360x190) is the confirmation dialog background, selected at ctor time.
The singleton object is 0x7E04C8; ctor 0x418030 with 8 args; base ctor 0x417FB0.
In-ctor centering rule (0x41808D-0x4180C3, anchor 400x246) is exercised by 6 of 7 callers via -1/-1 (payment push sequence verified).
The button class has a STATIC vtable 0x4763A8 (dtor/paint/hover/press/release); state byte +0x25; enabled byte +0x24.
Keyboard: TAB cycles active index 0x462; Enter/Space activates 0x418520.
Activation: MoveWindow/ShowWindow/GetWindowTextA/SetWindowTextA/SendMessageA(0x7EE, ((type<<8|idx)<<16)|tag, buffer) - all IAT names resolved (0x4762BC/0x4762AC/0x476304/0x4762CC/0x476290).

0x7EE receive side is closed primary-static: main WndProc 0x403E81 routes 0x7EE at 0x403FA4 to 0x404600 (chat-input buffer restore + 0x403640), second WndProc 0x459654 routes to 0x45A140 (type-gated game-object send via 0x452040/0x451F90); 0x7EE absent from message table 0x421E8C; the old candidate VAs 0x412303/0x412AAE/0x42AAB0/0x42C4D4 are the pre-0x7EE input router (click/visibility/top-window dispatch), not the receive (closed_notes 2026-08-11).
Cluster 2 is the independent hidden window 0x418910, not a confirm-box state.
All 7 call sites with original dialog strings identified; encodings are mixed GBK/CP949 (localization in progress).
pending: Runtime (in-memory/packet) confirmation of the payment amount flow: the typed amount is carried from the confirm box (this+0x130) through SendMessageA(0x7EE) and delivered to the game object receive handlers 0x404600 / 0x45A140, whose server send path uses 0x452040 + 0x451F90 (message builders with runtime-constructed payloads). closed_notes.key: 0x7EE final business processing in the main game window chain
closed_notes.conclusion: CONFIRMED primary-static, with the candidate VAs corrected: 0x7EE is NOT in the 40-entry message table 0x421E8C (only entries 0-19 are real, ids 0xf6ef..0xfb6e; 0x7EE absent) and is handled by two dedicated receive handlers. (1) Main game WndProc 0x403E81 switch at 0x403FA4: cmp ebp,0x7EE; jne 0x403FB5; push edi; push ebx; mov ecx,esi; call 0x404600. (2) Second window class WndProc switch at 0x459654: 0x7EE -> 0x45A140. 0x404600 (game object 0x8AB828): gate [obj+0x8A4]==1; zero 0x41 dwords @ obj+0xE3D; SetWindowTextA([0x8AA48C], [obj+0xD39]); [obj+0xD38]=1; call 0x403640; [0x8AA498]=0. 0x403640 = chat-input dual-buffer restore: GetWindowTextA/SetWindowTextA swap between obj+0xD39 and obj+0xE3D; MoveWindow([0x8AA48C], [0x8AB7F0]+obj+0xF44, [0x8AB7F4]+obj+0xF48, w, h, 1) with rect pair selected by [obj+0xD38] (alt rect obj+0xF54..0xF60); SendMessageA([0x8AA48C], 0xCC, 0 or 0x2A, 0); EM_SETSEL (0xB1, 0, -1) select-all when [0x8AB7E8]; SetFocus([0x8AA48C]). 0x45A140: wparam>>16 -> type byte; type==1 and idx(al) in {0,1} -> 0x452040(0x8AB828, this+0xCBF+idx*0x40) then 0x451F90(0x8AB828) (game-object server send); [this+0x930]==2 -> MoveWindow/ShowWindow(5)/SetFocus on chat input; [0x8AA498]=0. The previously cited candidate VAs are real elements of the SAME main-window input chain but NOT the 0x7EE receive: 0x412303 = confirm-box click routing (0x418400 on singleton 0x7E04C8) preceding 0x42AAB0 top-window resolution; 0x412AAE = confirm-box visibility query 0x418460 (returns [this+0x28]!=0) in the sibling mouse handler; 0x42C4D4 = window-id-indexed second-level dispatch jump table used by 'jmp dword ptr [edi*4+0x42C4D4]' at 0x42BF7E (cmp edi,0xE; ja 0x42C198; entries id0..14 = 0x42BF85..0x42C157, default 0x42C198), i.e. the per-top-window-id input router. Layout/draw/input conclusions unchanged.
